Monetary policy tension: Fed rate hike vs. political pressure from Trump
EM rotation: debt, China state capital, Nigeria IPO pipeline

Reduce discretionary exposure; favor essential/consumer staples; monitor fast-food and retail sentiment indicators

market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from energy shock (oil $98, diesel ATH), Fed rate-hike pressure, and European bond stress. AI hardware/connectivity provides relative strength. Expect elevated volatility; oil and FX are primary drivers. Consumer weakness and wage lag cap upside. 1-3 month: range-bound with downside risk on escalation.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month: AI infrastructure cycle (GPT-6 agents, semiconductor demand) supports tech earnings. EM debt and select equities offer yield. Energy transition (nuclear, pipelines) structurally supported. Consumer recovery delayed by energy costs. Fed likely to hike once more, then pause. Dollar weakness supports EM. Key risk: prolonged Iran conflict disrupting Hormuz.
